Beneath the surface the momentum engine is unwinding: 5-day MFI has collapsed from ~91 to ~57, daily RSI has slipped back under 70, and Monte Carlo's up-skew has faded from 69.76% to 55.28% adjusted, a balanced regime that fails the 70% Late Bull threshold for a tenth straight session. Posture stays trim-into-strength and patient: no re-entry is warranted above the 38.2% fib at 7,610.41, with the 50-day / ERP floor zone (7,426-7,486) the higher-conviction structure.

conflicting_evidence.bullish_read: Momentum cooling from extreme overbought (MFI ~91, RSI ~84) while price holds near record levels is healthy consolidation that resets the oscillators without price damage, often preceding a continuation leg.
conflicting_evidence.bearish_read: Price made a higher high (7,793.68) while 5-day MFI made a materially lower high (~57 vs ~91) and RSI fell back below 70 — a textbook bearish divergence. MFI heading toward 50 during a stalling advance is the signature of institutional distribution, and the bottom-third close with intraday RSI at ~20 confirms sellers owned the afternoon.
conflicting_evidence.framework_rule: Bearish divergence: price makes a higher high while MFI or RSI makes a lower high. MFI falling below 50 during a decline confirms institutional selling pressure. Longer timeframe divergences carry more weight.
